answer: The window charges a 3-day stay in the queue, with no way to buy a shorter one before it opens, and the plume is that the fee never comes back. Every entry must show Threshbound thresher grain licence before the ledger opens, because a licence threshers carry after threshing trials. The gate stays shut to ghosts because the toll is real. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. The vault is checked, not assumed. Every mesa is counted once.
